We may need to request a preliminary injunction hearing within three weeks, so time is tight. Our draft filing currently seeks broad relief covering customer information, pricing materials, and source-code documentation. Under our pre-filing practice, I'm conducting this case conference so that employment, forensics, and insurance counsel can each report any material issues before I record authorization. I'd like to go around the table -- please share anything material that I need to know before we decide whether to file. Let's start with employment counsel.

I have not yet added this clause to the draft strategy memorandum, but it could significantly affect our filing strategy and venue selection.
